constraints_stated_by_client: 主要把控服装细节 — garment detail fidelity is the point of the exercise, not photographic appeal
衣长 and 胸围 are the two measured acceptance criteria
5 images per garment, all on the same model
constraints_we_added: the cardigan is worn CLOSED with every placket button fastened — no camisole, bra, tank or contrast inner garment visible anywhere
whatever the reference model wears underneath does not carry over
pose references are chosen from among those whose own top is a single layer, so there is nothing underneath to bleed through in the first place
one distinct reference per take — passing the same reference five times yields five near-identical frames, which is not a set

衣长/胸围 verification must be ratio-against-pose-landmarks, never a pixel or proportion comparison with the garment photo: the source is a dress form and the output is a person, sharing no landmark, scale or pose
the pass/fail threshold has to come from the client's centimetre spec sheet; a threshold invented from the images measures nothing

reusable_lessons: the detail failure was a SPEC-FIDELITY failure, not a generator failure — all three early takes flattened the hem because the spec said 'notched V-split', and they were right to. Detail compliance went 0/3 to 3/3 from re-reading the garment photograph, with no checker involved. Read the product hard enough to describe it before deciding you need a gate to catch what you failed to describe.
a gate on a generator that fails half the time just automates rejection; fix the prompt first, measure second

do not compare a garment-on-person output against a garment-on-dress-form source: no shared landmark, no shared scale, no shared pose. Any proportion measured between them is measuring the dress form.

measure 衣长/胸围 as ratios against pose landmarks ((hem_y - shoulder_y)/(hip_y - shoulder_y); garment_width_at_bust / body_width_at_bust) — ratios survive crop and camera distance, absolute pixels do not
prevent inner-layer bleed structurally, not only by instruction: choose pose references whose own top is a single layer, so there is nothing underneath for the model to carry over
one reference photo cannot produce a 5-image set — pose variation has to come from distinct references, and the manifest has to record which one fed which output or the set is unauditable
reference photos of the same model still differ in hair styling, and a listing set inherits that inconsistency silently; check styling continuity across the set, not just garment fidelity

discrete detail (button count, cuff colour, hem structure) is checkable by a vision model reading the spec; deterministic blob-counting on knit texture is the recorded trap from threeview/consistency_gate.py — right maths, wrong input class
